instruction: On Xbox.com, use only the visible website interface to find a game listed under the Best sellers section. Open that game product page and report the exact game title, publisher, developer, and release date shown there. Do not finish until all four requested fields have been found on the visible product page. If one candidate product page does not visibly provide every field, return to Best sellers and choose a different game. Stop after opening a qualifying product page and recording all four fields. Do not sign in. Do not buy or download anything.
